messages:
Sam Ortiz: Kicking off catalog ingest for `equinox-3b-v2` into staging. Target deploy window: Thu 10:00am PT. Who can own smoke checks + rollback readiness?
Maya Chen: I can run smoke (infra + latency). Planning to start at 9:40 and run the standard 10-min suite. Will post results. :thumbsup:
Devon Patel: I'll handle the pin and routing. Plan is a 15% canary -> 100% after 30m if green. Command I'll run: `redwoodctl catalog pin --alias equinox-3b:staging --version equinox-3b-v2 --traffic 15%`
Lee Gomez: Need the quantized artifact uploaded to registry before pin. Upload ETA is 8:30am PT. I'll also push the staging image tag `equinox-3b-v2-q4` now.
Anika Roy: I'll own quality monitoring. Running the `equinox-regression` promptset against v2 and v1 beforehand. Quick ask: add auto-fallback rules for regressions >2% F1 drop or >700ms p90.
Sam Ortiz: Good call. Proposed fallback rule (ops will implement):
```json
{
  "fallback_on": {
    "error_rate_pct": 1.0,
    "latency_p90_ms": 700,
    "semantic_regression_pct": 2.0
  },
  "fallback_to": "equinox-3b-v1"
}
```
Maya Chen: Smoke checklist (I'll report pass/fail):
- infra health checks (GPU avail, mem)
- model load success (no OOM logs)
- sample prompt latency p50/p90 
- tokenization sanity check
- end-to-end inference correctness (10 golden prompts)
I'll paste logs if anything fails.
Devon Patel: Rollback steps documented for ops:
1) `redwoodctl catalog pin --alias equinox-3b:staging --version equinox-3b-v1 --traffic 100%`
2) de-prioritize v2 in routing rules
3) open incident channel and set `status=investigating` if automated fallback not triggered
I'll be on-call at deploy time.
ops-bot: Heads-up: scheduled maintenance window 09:00-09:15 will finish before uploads. No conflicts.
Lee Gomez: Uploaded quantized model and artifact SHA: `sha256:fa3b...9d2`. Registry link: https://registry.redwood.internal/models/equinox-3b-v2-q4
Anika Roy: Quick eval note: v2 shows slight drop on "math-narrow" prompt (F1 -1.8%). Not a hard blocker but monitor. I'll tag specific prompts in the eval board.
Sam Ortiz: Given that, let's proceed with canary. Owners: Maya (smoke), Devon (pin + routing), Anika (qa + eval watches), Lee (artifact + infra). Be online 09:30-11:30 PT.
Maya Chen: I'll post a short smoke report at 9:55 and a green/red at 10:20.
Devon Patel: I'll set canary config to 15% for 30m then auto-promote if no alerts. Config I'll apply: 
```
rollout:
  initial_traffic: 0.15
  canary_window_min: 30
  promote_on: no_errors && latency_p90 < 650
```
Anika Roy: If we hit that math regression, do we want to reduce traffic to 5% first or rollback immediately?
Sam Ortiz: Reduce to 5% and run narrow eval run. If regression persists, rollback. Keep ops looped. :rotating_light:
qa-bot: Reminder: Please annotate any failures with `#staging-equinox` tag.
Maya Chen: All set from infra side. Will kick off health checks at 09:40 and paste outputs. :eyes:
Devon Patel: I'll wait for Maya's green then pin. I'll also keep a CLI session open to execute rollback quickly.
Sam Ortiz: Thanks team — will confirm final go/no-go at 09:50 in this thread.
Maya Chen: GREEN at 09:56 — infra good, no OOMs, latency p90=430ms on sample set.
Devon Patel: Pinning now to 15%... pinned. Traffic routed.
Anika Roy: Running focused evals now. First pass: no new systemic regressions aside from the earlier math narrow drop. Monitoring dashboards for p95/p99.
Devon Patel: Auto-promote scheduled at 10:30 if no alerts.
Sam Ortiz: Keep this thread updated. If anything goes sideways, call it in #incidents and tag @oncall.
Maya Chen: If anything shows up in logs I'll paste snippets, otherwise will confirm promote at 10:32.
Anika Roy: Post-canary check in ~20m with final evaluation.
Devon Patel: Promoted to 100% at 10:33 — traffic now 100% to equinox-3b-v2.
Maya Chen: Post-deploy smoke all good. No errors, p90=455ms.
Anika Roy: Final eval: math narrow still -1.6% in some cases, but not affecting user-facing prompts we care about. Marking as monitor-only for now.
Sam Ortiz: Closing the deploy thread — v2 is live in staging and promoted to staging alias. We'll open a separate thread for production pin after cross-team signoff. Great work :tada:
